We release a benchmark of 15 labelled cases for wildfire risk estimation and report baselines including a graph neural network. All data in this example are synthetic.

title: Synthetic example 99: gradient-boosted trees for sea-ice concentration mapping
abstract: Accurate sea-ice concentration mapping matters for planning and early warning, but existing approaches struggle with rare, high-impact events. We evaluate gradient-boosted trees for sea-ice concentration mapping across 3 regions and find gains concentrated in extreme events. All data in this example are synthetic.
